records.region: Santiago–Cayapas drainage and northern Esmeraldas coastal setting
records.material_pending_reason: No inspected original continuously establishes the selected headward opening, long eastern arc, tributary opening and intervening through-links. The actual lower terminal connection is also untraced. Basin membership and prose name anchors do not replace these substantive geographic links.
records.geographic_disambiguation: Río Santiago is a regional receiving-corridor candidate, with Río Cayapas retained as a distinct selected-side-branch candidate. Complete selected-route correspondence has not been established, so neither name is accepted for the whole feature or every fragment.
records.completion_scope: All five supplied fragments were considered, including both selected tributary fragments, intermediate joins and the actual terminal. Available evidence is regional prose, basin areas and settlement context. Continuous selected-channel correspondence remains incomplete.
records.supported_name_scope: Río Santiago is a regional receiving-corridor candidate, with Río Cayapas retained as a distinct selected-side-branch candidate. Complete selected-route correspondence has not been established, so neither name is accepted for the whole feature or every fragment.

scope_limits: The candidate names are bounded regional/component names. No whole-selected-system representative identity is completed.

Distinct basin nomenclature in the municipal plan and OAS prose is not resolved into one formal scalar. This is retained within the single material-pending status, not counted as a completed naming-scope hold.
The selected terminal is not reassigned to an assumed ocean mouth; its ordinary through-connection lacks inspected source cartography.
No formal registry, precise bank, present flow, current navigability or management condition was verified.

records.region: Northeastern Yucatán Peninsula; Quintana Roo interior to Yucatán coastal estuarine setting
records.material_pending_reason: No source establishes the actual selected opening, long inland continuation and its joining link into the northern wetland as one connected river. Coastal estuarine correspondence alone cannot supply that missing evidence.
records.geographic_disambiguation: No whole selected river-system identity established. Estero Río Lagartos is retained only as a bounded coastal component; lagoon and locality labels are not whole-river aliases.
records.completion_scope: All35 selected parts were considered against three successfully acquired original sheets using five overlapping readable source views and separate private orientation aids. Complete map-footprint coverage does not close the substantive watercourse and connector gaps.
records.supported_name_scope: No whole selected river-system identity established. Estero Río Lagartos is retained only as a bounded coastal component; lagoon and locality labels are not whole-river aliases.

scope_limits: An unshown generalized channel is not proof that no local watercourse or local name exists.
The inland-to-wetland continuity gap is substantive; it is not a request for precise banks, current flow or operating data.
No formal naming boundaries or lagoon aliases for the full158.366km model are established.
Cartography dated2023 does not establish present water levels, discharge, groundwater paths or salina operations.

records.geographic_disambiguation: Representative identity of the selected connected Huacraruco–San Juan–Magdalena–Chilete–Jequetepeque main-river system, including the Gallito Ciego impounded corridor and the Pacific terminal. Distinct upstream reach and reservoir names are retained.
records.completion_scope: All material selected components and joins are supported at ordinary corridor scale. No geographic gap, additional source-access pending category or completed scope hold is needed. Formal acceptance, Korean naming, whole-feature scalar naming and product application remain unset.
records.supported_name_scope: Representative identity of the selected connected Huacraruco–San Juan–Magdalena–Chilete–Jequetepeque main-river system, including the Gallito Ciego impounded corridor and the Pacific terminal. Distinct upstream reach and reservoir names are retained.

scope_limits: Representative identity only. Upstream Huacraruco, San Juan, Magdalena and Chilete labels and Gallito Ciego reservoir identity are not overwritten.
The selected eastern opening is covered by the mapped Huacraruco corridor, but is not equated with a surveyed ultimate source or the small source lagoon described in the report.
The sources generalize geography and use differing reach/confluence wording, including Puclush/Puglush/San Miguel. Exact name-transition vertices remain unassigned.
Gallito Ciego and the downstream intake are geographically established at ordinary regional scale. Current storage, flow, gate state and precise infrastructure paths were not investigated.
The map is2007 and the hydrological report2017. They establish geographic/naming correspondence, not a2026 channel-bank survey or formal registry verification.

records.region: Northern Patagonia, Argentina; the uplands north of Sierra Colorada and Ministro Ramos Mexía toward the Bajo de Trapalcó setting.
records.material_pending_reason: The practical independent source pass did not yield continuous corridor-scale mapping. The acquired CFI–ARSE report describes relevant named drainage but omits the map appendices listed in its contents; the separate geophysical figure and archaeological prose supply regional context only.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The selection runs from the southern uplands eastward, then northeast and north toward the Trapalcó lowland. The acquired sources establish regional names and context, but not all selected through-links. Nearby canyon labels and model connectivity are not used to assign a representative hydronym.

completion_scope.headward_scope: Unresolved selected feeder and southern course; no map-based correspondence claimed.
completion_scope.lake_and_wetland_scope: Regional temporary lagoons and dry canyons are described, but no individual lagoon, salt-flat, wetland, or managed connection is assigned to the selection without geographic correspondence.
completion_scope.actual_terminal_setting: The selected end is in the broader Bajo de Trapalcó inland region. Available source detail does not establish the exact selected receiving passage; no Río Negro or ocean outlet is asserted.
unresolved_material_connections: Selected headward opening and eastward upper corridor
Course correspondence and tributary joins in the northeast-trending middle corridor
Lower depression passages and the actual terminal approach
completion_scope.gap_character: A material geographic-source gap, not a completed naming-scope hold and not merely the absence of one uniform name.

records.supported_name_scope: No selected-system name assigned. Independently read regional hydrography identifies Cullen Leufú, also called Cuyún Leufú, and Mallín Chico, but the available material does not establish which full selected intervals belong to them.

scope_limits: The regional Cullen Leufú/Cuyún Leufú name is not yet geographically assigned to the selected feature.
The absence of inspected channel mapping does not establish that any selected reach lacks a natural drainage or local name.
Source publication dates are historical; present flow, permanence, water levels and contemporary hydraulic behavior are not inferred.
A representative system could include multiple local names once full geographic correspondence is established; a uniform scalar name is not required.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
